CAVEAT (1) OF THAT NOTE IS NOW CLOSED, AND IT RESOLVED AGAINST THE 13.0mm PITCH -- PITCH RE-DERIVED 2026-08-12 TO 18.0mm. The 2026-07-29 note said: 'if the finalized L pushes working voltage above 400V, this 13.0mm/5.0mm figure is a floor, not sufficient, and must be re-derived at the higher voltage ... a >400V case needs a fresh standard lookup, not extrapolation from this table'. That condition is met: the tank node's working voltage is now MEASURED, not assumed, at 570.5 Vrms / 923.7 V peak (docs/evidence/2026-08-12-hv-clearance-adequacy.md; this pad pair specifically carries tank.c_tank1-p2 <-> tank-out, i.e. essentially the tank<->PWR_RTN voltage at 544.6 Vrms -- same Table 18 row). The fresh lookup was done and it is a DIFFERENT table and a different pollution degree from the superseded one: IEC 60335-1 Table 18 (functional insulation creepage), band >500-800V, material group IIIa/IIIb, POLLUTION DEGREE 3 -> 10.0mm. PD3 governs, not the PD2 this footprint's previous derivation used: IEC 60335-2-6 cl. 29.2's Addition makes PD3 the default for cooking appliances, and the sealed compartment PD2 would be conditional on is both unbuilt and thermally counterproductive (docs/evidence/2026-08-12-pollution-degree-resolution.md; docs/evidence/2026-08-11-pd2-decision-record.md; docs/evidence/2026-08-12-hv-hv-creepage-determination.md for the Table 18 derivation). So the PD3/Table 18 lookup SUPERSEDES the PD2/Table 16 400V lookup that produced 13.0mm -- that older figure is not a floor that happened to be raised, it was read from a table that does not apply to this node. New pitch 18.0mm = 8.0mm pad dia + 10.0mm creepage; measured pad-edge-to-pad-edge gap is exactly 10.0mm. Coating this pair down to PD1 was considered and is NOT available: IEC 60664-3 cl. 4.3 requires the conductive part to be COVERED by the coating, and these two pads are bare litz-wire terminations that must stay uncoated to be soldered to. Note that the diameter and the pitch are coupled: the 18.0mm pitch is derived AS 'diameter + 10.0mm', so if the diameter is later sourced at anything other than 8.0mm the pitch must move with it, or the 10.0mm creepage is silently lost. PAD DIAMETER SOURCED (partially -- see the still-open item below) AND PITCH RE-DERIVED 2026-08-13, CLOSING CAVEAT (2) ABOVE'S CURRENT-CAPACITY HALF: this pad is R30, the tank coil's own bare litz-wire solder termination, NOT a purchased connector -- confirmed against docs/hardware/TANK_COIL_SPECIFICATION.md req #10 ('two leads, tinned, for through-hole pads') and docs/hardware/BOM.md L_TANK line ('2 leads to LitzPad_15A pads'); docs/CONNECTORS_AND_WIRING.md's J_COIL M4-screw-terminal entry is a stale v1.0 (2025-12-17) document with no corresponding component in elec/src or docs/hardware/BOM.md and does not describe the as-built design. The name 'LitzPad_15A' is kept unchanged on purpose, the same way R30 keeps a deliberately wrong 'R' prefix (see modules.ato) -- renaming the footprint would desync it from the fp-lib-table reference baked into every R30 footprint instance already placed on pcb/temper.kicad_pcb (out of scope for this change), so the 15A in the name is now historical, not descriptive; the true rating is elec/src/footprints.ato's pad.current_rating field, updated alongside this file. The name was found to UNDER-declare, not over-declare: the tank carries 20.7A rms (this repo's ngspice harness) to 22.5A rms (independent first-harmonic solve, docs/hardware/TANK_COIL_SPECIFICATION.md Sec 3) continuous at the 1800W point -- compared like-for-like against this pad's declared 15A CONTINUOUS rating (not peak; a 28.7-31.9A peak-vs-15A-continuous comparison, as docs/hardware/PART_STRESS_AUDIT.md Sec 1.3 makes, mixes bases), the pad was already carrying 1.38-1.5x its declared continuous rating before this fix. IPC-2221B (docs/hardware/TRACE_WIDTH_CALCULATIONS.md Sec 2, I = k x dT^0.44 x A^0.725, external k=0.048) at this board's own 2oz/70um outer copper (TRACE_WIDTH_CALCULATIONS.md Sec 1) and this net's own established 40C rise allowance (TRACE_WIDTH_CALCULATIONS.md Sec 3.1/3.3/Sec4, 'HighVoltage'/'Resonant Tank' rows) requires A = (25 / (0.048 x 40^0.44))^(1/0.725) = 595.5 mils^2 = 0.384mm^2 of copper cross-section, i.e. an equivalent single-direction conductor width of 595.5 / (2 x 1.37) = 217.3 mils = 5.52mm. New pad diameter = 3.0mm drill + 2 x 6.0mm ring = 15.0mm.
